messages:
Alex P: Heads up — thinking about a 'quiet switchback' behavior for auto-fallback. We need UX + audit model. Quick thoughts?
Maria C: :thinking: By 'quiet switchback' do you mean route traffic back to primary model gradually without loud alerts? Or silent background probe?
Samir D: I'd say 'probe' mode: route a small fraction back, collect errors/quality, then flip. UI should show 'probing' badge + metric timeline.
Jo K: Audit is key. Every automatic decision needs an event_id + snapshot of metric state. Searchable in console.
Priya S: Operator override needed — sticky pin so ops can stop auto switchback for a route. Also a manual 'force-revert' button.
Lina (SRE): Telemetry idea: emit these events: fallback_trigger, probe_start, probe_sample, probe_result, switchback_attempt, switchback_complete. Each with event_id, route, model, snapshot of p50/p95/5xx/quality_score.
Dev Console: UI suggestion: small unobtrusive toast when probe starts; a 'Probe' row in the route timeline with a link to a realtime mini-dashboard (metrics + traces). Also a 'why' hover that shows decision conditions.
Alex P: What should trigger probes? 5xx ratio? latency? quality drop from evals? Lots of noise if we do simple thresholds.
Samir D: Multi-signal policy: e.g. (5xx_rate > 0.02 AND sustained for 2m) OR (p95 > 1.5s AND increase > 2x) OR (quality_score drop > 5%). Then start probe with fraction=1% -> 10% -> full. Add cooldown 10m. Hysteresis prevents flapping.
Dev Console: Example policy snippet:
```
{ "policy": "auto_switchback", "conditions": [{"metric":"5xx_rate","op":">","value":0.02,"window":"2m"}], "probe": {"steps":["1%","10%","100%"], "step_interval":"3m"}, "cooldown":"10m" }
```
Priya S: Sampling details: record full payload hashes for sampled probe requests so we can do quality comparisons, but keep sample size small for PII concerns.
Alex P: Audit retention? default 90d, but enterprise can request longer. Must include operator id for manual overrides.
ops-bot: auto-fallback: probe_start event created: event_id=ef3a1b, route=/v1/generate, from_model=redwood-7b, reason=5xx_spike :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary rollback observed on infra stack, not related to policy (FYI)
Maria C: UX ask: we need three affordances: (1) see probe in timeline, (2) see decision rationale, (3) quick action buttons (pause probe, pin override, force revert). Keep default UX quiet so customers don't get alert fatigue.
Samir D: Also surface 'confidence' metric for probe results (stat sig) before full switchback.
Jo K: For auditability, attach a compact 'decision snapshot' JSON to each event + links to the metric timeseries used.
Lina (SRE): Will add telemetry schema draft to the infra repo — include event types and field list (event_id, ts, route, model, reason, metrics, sampled_payload_ids, operator).
Priya S: Security note: sampled payloads must be encrypted at rest and access logged.
Maria C: I'll mock the console flow today and add the 'probe' badge states: pending -> probing -> pass/fail -> switched.
Alex P: Awesome. Ping here when mock + event spec ready. Thanks everyone :)
